A '''transpirator''' was a device used as an assist for the respiratory system, similar in form and function to a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]]. It was known to be used by members of the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] species.<ref name="SWDP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

In [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] wore a transpirator mask to protect his respiratory system from the superheated air of the [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]] grotto, where he and his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]], [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]], who wore a similar mask, were inspecting [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] deposits. After an [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|attempt on his life]] by [[Maladian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] [[52 BBY/Legends|15 years later]] left Plagueis with a severed trachea and a large part of his jawbone missing, he was forced to wear a transpirator mask permanently until the end of his life. The device was affixed to the upper part of his chest and protected by an armored torso harness.<ref name="SWDP" />
